certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.note: Certification period is expired as of July 2026. No evidence of renewal to 2025 or 2026 found. This is a potential gap — vendor documentation may be outdated.

certifications.name: SOC 3
certifications.note: Certification period is expired as of July 2026. No evidence of renewal found.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act). Ada provides HIPAA-compliant configuration and Business Associate Agreements (BAA) for healthcare and insurance customers
certifications.note: HIPAA is a compliance regime; Ada offers BAA and HIPAA-compliant workflows. Not a formal third-party certification like SOC 2, but operational compliance with HIPAA requirements.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation). Stated as industry-leading compliance. Data Processing Addendum available. Data residency in EU (Ireland, Germany) via AWS.
certifications.note: GDPR is a regulatory compliance posture, not a formal certification. Ada has DPA and demonstrates compliance practices.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification on ada.cx or security.ada.cx. Third-party sources (Fini Labs) claim Ada holds ISO 27001, but this is not corroborated by Ada's own trust center or security documentation.
certifications.note: Ada's trust center lists SOC 2, SOC 3, HIPAA, GDPR, PIPEDA, CCPA/CPRA, VPAT, but does NOT list ISO 27001. While third-party comparison sites claim Ada is ISO 27001 certified, no vendor-domain proof is available. Flag: potential over-claim in third-party marketing materials.

certifications.name: AIUC-1
certifications.proof_quote: AIUC-1. 'First AI-agent-specific standard; Ada was the first customer service platform to earn this certification'
certifications.note: Ada helped shape this standard and became the first AI customer service platform to earn AIUC-1 certification. This is a first-mover advantage and distinct from traditional security certs.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: PCI Attestation of Compliance mentioned in security documentation
certifications.note: Attestation of Compliance (AOC) available, indicating PCI DSS scope and compliance. Typically required for payment processing; Ada's scope is unclear from public docs.

certifications.name: CCPA / CPRA
certifications.proof_quote: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act) and CPRA (California Privacy Rights Act) compliance stated
certifications.note: Privacy law compliance posture, not a formal certification.

certifications.name: PIPEDA
certifications.proof_quote: PIPEDA (Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act) compliance stated
certifications.note: Canadian privacy law compliance. Ada is Canadian-based (Toronto), so this is expected.

certifications.name: VPAT
certifications.proof_quote: VPAT (Voluntary Product Accessibility Template) listed in compliance certifications
certifications.note: Accessibility attestation; indicates conformance to WCAG or Section 508 standards.

flags: SOC 2 Type 2 and SOC 3 certifications show an expiry date of September 30, 2024. No evidence of renewal to 2025 or 2026 was found. Vendor documentation appears outdated.

Third-party sources (Fini Labs, fin.ai) claim Ada is ISO 27001 certified, but no direct evidence is found on ada.cx or security.ada.cx. Ada's own trust center does not list ISO 27001 as a held certification, so third-party marketing materials may overstate Ada's certification status.
HIPAA is listed as a 'compliance' posture with BAA availability, not a formal third-party certification like SOC 2.
Not to be confused with ada.com, a separate company and domain. This report covers ada.cx, the Toronto-based AI customer service platform.
Ada is enterprise-grade (1.2B valuation, 350+ enterprise customers, 2026 operations). However, expired SOC 2 dates and a lack of current ISO 27001 evidence suggest documentation or renewal lag.
